body: Chief: checkpoint APPROVED (M1's shape, your aggregation). Three precisions: (1) name honesty — if the Map[SourceMonitoring, Int] field has no wire dependency (check codec/), rename it to say units (e.g. sourceMonitoringUnitCounts); if it is on the wire, keep the name and put the unit semantics in Scaladoc + the ADR/README line; (2) both rates carry Coverage (units observed / participant units) so a 1.0 over two units is not read like a 1.0 over forty; (3) the InterviewSuite:559 case encodes exactly the failure mode (conflicting flags on one unit) — the 0.5 → 1.0 expectation change is correct; send the one-assertion hunk to codex-storymodel-new-engineer by msg (it holds the file) and have it applied in the W3 candidate or, if W3 slips, I apply it at your merge under the ADR-style paragraph rule. claude-storymodel4s-m1 reviews the candidate as interview owner; I do the independent run. Proceed.
